description: Golden retrieval pairs: hand-written queries with the memory items a good retriever must surface. Six synthetic personas, no real personal data. Tags: lexical (shared vocabulary), paraphrase (reworded, partial overlap), semantic (no vocabulary overlap; BM25 is expected to miss), multi (several relevant items).

backend_migration.content: Priya is a backend engineer at a fintech startup
Building a payments reconciliation service in Python
Use PostgreSQL instead of SQLite for production
Prefers SQLAlchemy 2.0 style with typed models rather than raw SQL
Every ledger entry must be idempotent because upstream webhooks can be delivered twice
Write the Alembic migration for the ledger table and backfill historical rows
Deadline is the end of Q3, about six weeks away
Run the service on Kubernetes with a horizontal pod autoscaler
Stripe and Adyen are the two payment providers being reconciled
Add Prometheus metrics for reconciliation lag and mismatch count
Wants pull requests kept under 400 lines
Retry failed webhook processing with exponential backoff capped at one hour

thesis_research.content: Marco is a second-year PhD student in computational linguistics
Thesis on low-resource machine translation for Ladin
Fine-tune NLLB-200 as the base translation model
Only about 40,000 parallel sentence pairs are available for training
Wants citations formatted in APA style
Run the back-translation augmentation experiment on the Italian side
The advisor meeting is every Tuesday at 10am
Evaluate with chrF and COMET rather than BLEU alone
Submit the workshop paper draft to the LoResMT deadline in November
Compute budget is one A100 GPU shared with two other students
Prefers PyTorch Lightning over raw training loops
The Ladin corpus was digitised from regional newspapers between 1990 and 2010

product_launch.content: Dana is a product manager at a B2B analytics company
Preparing the launch of the new usage-based pricing tier
Launch date is set for October 14
Enterprise customers must be grandfathered on their current contracts
Write the customer-facing FAQ and the sales enablement deck
Wants documents as bullet-point summaries, not long prose
The free tier keeps 1,000 events per month
Legal review of the new terms takes at least ten business days
Schedule the webinar with the marketing team for the week after launch
Churn risk analysis flagged 12 accounts likely to downgrade
Overage will be billed monthly in arrears at $0.002 per event
Prefers Notion over Google Docs for planning pages

home_renovation.content: Sam and Lee own a 1970s semi-detached house in Leeds
Renovating the kitchen and knocking through to the dining room
Chose quartz worktops in a light grey finish
The wall between kitchen and dining room is load-bearing and needs a steel beam
Get a structural engineer's calculation for the RSJ
Going with an induction hob instead of gas
Apply for building regulations approval with the council
Wants matte black tap and handles
Builder is available from the first week of March
Keep the existing boiler; it was replaced two years ago
Avoids high-gloss cabinet doors because they show fingerprints

data_pipeline.content: Aisha leads the data platform team at an e-commerce retailer
Migrating nightly batch ETL to a streaming pipeline on Kafka
Use Apache Flink for stream processing rather than Spark Structured Streaming
Order events peak at 20,000 per second during flash sales
Store curated tables in Iceberg format on S3
Define the schema registry compatibility rules for the orders topic
Finance needs revenue figures reconciled to the cent by 6am daily
Prefers dbt for transformations so analysts can contribute
Set up dead-letter queues and alerting for malformed events
The legacy Informatica jobs will be decommissioned by year end
Wants infrastructure defined in Terraform, no console changes
Exactly-once semantics are required for the payments topic

Rewrite the resume summary to emphasise design-system work

Second interview with Northwind is scheduled for Thursday at 2pm
Prepare a portfolio walkthrough of the accessibility overhaul project
Wants to avoid roles that require relocating to the Bay Area
Has a notice period of one month at the current employer
Will learn TypeScript generics properly before the system design round
The recruiter at Fabrikam said the team uses Next.js and Tailwind
